title: Q-WORKERS-201: Wire the tick steps and routes of the spec build-out modules into core/org (on by default)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** grep:workers/core/org/index.js::core/signals
**Status:** done: tick steps in `workers/core/org/buildout.js` (#211); routes and ports in `workers/core/org/surfaces.js`, tested in `workers/core/org/surfaces.test.js`

Moved from ultrastable/workers#201 (workers repo archived; code now under workers/ here, issues disabled on this repo).

**Problem and context.** ultrastable/workers#198 merged these modules with their migrations in the org build, but their tick steps and routes are not called by `core/org/index.js` yet:
- `core/staff`, `core/plus`, `core/lifecycle-gates`
- `core/fleet`, `core/signals`, `core/remediation`, `core/claims/gate.js`, `core/graph/wiring.js`
- `core/predict`, `core/trust`, `core/governance`, `core/ladder`
- `core/sla`, `core/console-l3/dashboard.js`, `core/walkthrough`, `core/doors/proxy.js`, `core/modelport`
- `core/ghcost`, `core/tenancy`, `adapters/github/stage2.js`, `adapters/shared/slot.js`

Each module's README lists its step signature, ports and config switch. Only `core/specloop` and `core/criticality` run by default today.

**Done check.** Each step is in `extraSteps` and runs on by default unless its config says `enabled: false`; routes are mounted behind auth; each affected spec status line drops "not yet called by the composition root".

**Closing probe.** `npm test`, plus a `core/org` test that asserts every listed step name appears in `org.extraSteps()`.

**Owner role.** staff. **Size.** L. **Spec.** US-SPEC-02 to 24 (status lines that say the step is not wired).

**Closing probe:** `grep:workers/core/org/index.js::core/signals`
